name: stitchwort
description: Syntax colouring and, through the `stitchwort lsp` language server, diagnostics as you type, go to definition, hover, references and outline for Stitchwort (.sw) files

semanticTokenTypes.description: A theorem, or a proof of one
An ability (an effect) and its operations' namespace

stitchwort.path.markdownDescription: The `stitchwort` command line program. The extension starts `stitchwort lsp` from it, and reads library source with `stitchwort std-source`. A bare name is looked up on PATH.

stitchwort.inlayHints.letTypes.description: Show the type after a `let` whose type isn't written.

stitchwort.codeLens.run.description: Show the Run and Run test icons above `main` and each `test`.

stitchwort.proofSearch.enabled.description: Offer proofs that close a goal `?`, found by searching, as quick fixes.

stitchwort.proofSearch.timeLimitMs.description: How long a proof search may run, in milliseconds, before it gives up with what it has found.

stitchwort.semanticColours.description: Colour names by what the checker found them to be (functions, types, theorems and so on), beyond the syntax colouring.

stitchwort.goals.openAutomatically.description: Open the Goals panel when you open a `.sw` file that has a goal `?`.
